_help: Newest first is not required: the build sorts by date. Required per item: id, date (YYYY-MM-DD), title and summary in en/hu/ro. Optional: body (paragraphs separated by a blank line), quote {text, who}, image {src, alt{en,hu,ro}}, link {url, label{en,hu,ro}}. A missing language falls back to English.
